# DiceFrame — Full LLM Context & Platform Specification

> DiceFrame is an open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted AI tabletop role-playing (TRPG) platform. It connects an AI Game Master (AI GM/KP), a real-time multiplayer WebUI, character sheets, lorebooks (world books), dice rolling, validated game-state tracking, and group-chat bot bridges into one persistent online campaign.
>
> 官方网站：https://diceframe.com (中文) · https://diceframe.com/en (English)
> 开源代码库：https://github.com/diceframe/diceframe
> 文档库：https://github.com/diceframe/diceframe-content
> 开源协议：GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)

---

## 1. Core Architecture & Facts

- **Product Category**: AI TRPG Engine & Campaign Platform.
- **Architecture Principle**: Clean separation between probabilistic natural language narrative (generated by LLMs) and deterministic game state (HP, inventory, currency, skill checks, sanity, status effects enforced by the internal engine).
- **Deployment Mode**: 100% self-hosted. Available as a Windows portable package, Docker container, Linux service, or local source build. No hosted SaaS or subscription required. Saves, credentials, world settings, and game logs remain entirely local.
- **Model Support**: Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK). Compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, vLLM, and any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint.
- **Supported Rulesets**:
  - DND 5e (Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition)
  - Call of Cthulhu (COC 7th Edition)
  - Freeform Custom Rules (fully customizable rule parameters, character sheet schemas, and world books)
- **Multiplayer Collaboration**: Real-time multi-user WebUI using Server-Sent Events (SSE). Supports invite link sharing, seat claiming, turn-taking queues, away/pause states, and GM interventions.
- **Memory & Long Context System**:
  - Structured World Books (Lorebooks) with keyword/regex auto-injection.
  - Automatic rolling summaries for long-running campaigns.
  - Optional vector embeddings for semantic memory retrieval.
- **Chat Bot Bridge**: Connects web game sessions with QQ group chat via NapCat / OneBot / Lagrange adapters. Players can roll dice, query status, view previous story turns, and submit actions directly inside chat groups.

---

## 2. Feature Breakdown (自包含特性说明)

### 01. AI GM with Rule Enforcement (AI GM，不抢走规则)
DiceFrame separates narrative generation from structured game state. The LLM acts as the storyteller while DiceFrame validates damage calculations, inventory transfers, coin balances, and ability check thresholds before writing them to persistent save files.

### 02. Real-Time Multiplayer Table (一张实时多人桌)
DiceFrame synchronizes player actions, invite links, character claims, action queues, pause statuses, and GM turns across all connected browsers using low-latency Server-Sent Events (SSE).

### 03. Persistent Memory & Lorebooks (世界会记得)
DiceFrame dynamically injects lorebook entries using keyword recognition, condenses historical turns via automatic narrative summaries, and performs semantic recall with vector embeddings to keep story continuity intact across extended campaigns.

### 04. Flexible & Editable Rules (规则不被写死)
DiceFrame includes built-in templates for DND 5e and Call of Cthulhu (COC), while providing a freeform engine allowing game masters to customize rulesets, character sheet fields, and world backgrounds.

### 05. Group Chat Integration (从网页走进群聊)
DiceFrame bridges active web campaigns to QQ and chat groups through bot adapters (such as NapCat), enabling players to submit actions, inspect character status, review recap digests, and roll dice directly from group chat.

### 06. Sovereign Local Deployment (部署在你手里)
DiceFrame runs on Windows portable distributions, Docker containers, Linux servers, and NAS appliances. Game saves, credentials, configuration profiles, and API tokens remain completely in the host operator's environment.

---

## 3. Deployment & Quick Start (快速开始)

### Docker Launch (One Command)
```bash
docker run -d \
  -p 9876:9876 \
  -v ./data:/app/data \
  --name diceframe \
  ghcr.io/diceframe/diceframe:latest
```
After starting the container, open `http://localhost:9876` in a web browser.

### Four-Step Getting Started
1. **Deploy**: Download the Windows release or start with Docker.
2. **Configure**: Select a ruleset (DND 5e, COC, or Freeform) and provide your LLM API endpoint and key.
3. **Assemble Party**: Create characters and share the invite URL with friends (or bind to a QQ group).
4. **Play**: Declare player actions, resolve skill checks with transparent dice rolls, and advance the story together.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is DiceFrame?
DiceFrame is an open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted AI TRPG platform. It integrates an AI Game Master, multiplayer WebUI, character sheets, lorebooks, dice, and state tracking into one persistent campaign, with optional QQ group chat integration.

### Which TRPG systems does DiceFrame support?
DiceFrame natively supports:
- DND 5e (Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition)
- Call of Cthulhu (COC)
- Freeform rules (allowing custom attributes, character cards, and rule scripts)

### Is DiceFrame free or does it require cloud accounts?
DiceFrame is completely free and open source under the AGPL-3.0 license. Users run it locally and use their own LLM API keys. No SaaS accounts, subscriptions, or telemetry tracking exist.

### Does DiceFrame work with DeepSeek? / DiceFrame 支持 DeepSeek 吗？
Yes. DiceFrame talks to models through OpenAI-compatible APIs, so DeepSeek, SiliconFlow (硅基流动), OpenAI, and Ollama all work. For DeepSeek: create an API key on https://platform.deepseek.com/, then in DiceFrame open Manage → Settings → Model API (管理 → 设置 → 模型接口), add a provider with the base URL https://api.deepseek.com, paste the key, save model IDs such as deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-v4-flash, and select DeepSeek as the main model. Model IDs follow the catalog the provider returns. DiceFrame is free; model usage is billed by the provider.
支持。DiceFrame 通过 OpenAI 兼容接口连接大模型，可接入 DeepSeek、硅基流动、OpenAI、Ollama 等服务；DeepSeek 的接口地址为 https://api.deepseek.com。

### Why use DiceFrame instead of just chatting with an AI? / 直接用聊天 AI 跑团还需要 DiceFrame 吗？
A chat window is fine for a light solo session. DiceFrame adds an engine that rolls dice before the AI narrates and validates HP, items, currency, and checks before saving; lorebooks, history condensing, and optional embedding recall for long campaigns; and a shared multiplayer table that spans the web and QQ group chat. It ships no model of its own — bring an API key such as DeepSeek's.

### Can friends play together online?
Yes. DiceFrame provides instant invite links for multiplayer web sessions and can also bridge the session to QQ groups via NapCat so friends can participate simultaneously across web and chat.

### Where can I get documentation and community support?
- Web Documentation: https://diceframe.com/docs/guide
- GitHub Source: https://github.com/diceframe/diceframe
- QQ Community Group: 1060613588
